caption: The drawing shows a collection of objects commonly associated with a candlestick or lighting apparatus rendered in pencil and accented with shades of gold and gray. In the center, there is a standing candle holder with a tall vertical rod ending in a pointed finial, supported at the base by three curved legs that form a tripod. Extending horizontally from near the top of the central rod are two short arms, each holding a candle with a visible flame and a small round tray below. To the left, there is a close-up of a spoon-shaped object above a detailed depiction of a separate, smaller candle holder with a wide circular base and a hook protruding from the edge of the base. On the right side of the central holder, a detailed technical drawing shows a mechanical part consisting of a vertical rod surrounded by a frame with coils or springs, attached to a horizontal bar. The composition is arranged on a vertically oriented rectangular background within a thin, single-line border. The artist's signature "J. Staloff" appears at the bottom center of the drawing.
title: Candlestand
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
